note: SHG trap metrology exists commercially; metrology cannot itself make low-T oxidation reach thermal-oxide Dit.
ALILE leaves heavily Al-doped p-type Si; grain placement control at DRAM pitch is the key doubt.
Close to 1S1C threshold-switch art; read and retention see similar TS bias, and Ag filament endurance is far below DRAM needs.
Raman spot exceeds channel size; per-device RBM census does not scale; CNT FETs widely pursued.
Te/SeTe FETs known; Se-rich films have low mobility and poor thermal stability at DRAM operating temperatures.
Microwave low-T activation widely studied; reflected-power endpointing is a minor twist.
STM hydrogen lithography is known; throughput for billions of access devices needs a miracle.
Amorphous gates to suppress work-function variation have prior art in logic; modest tail gain.
Stress chips and package-stress retention effects known; 10-30% retention recovery is incremental.
Cheap per-die multi-temperature retention screening; heat sinking into wafer and test-time claims need checking.
CoolCube-style low-T bonding and pseudo-MOSFET metrology are known; junction activation still needs low-T solution.
SAM/AlOx hybrid dielectrics known from organic TFTs; tunneling leakage and thermal stability doubtful for DRAM.
Measuring leakage in-reactor needs a top contact on fresh film; gain about 2x on dielectric leakage share.
DRAM ZrO2 already crystallizes tetragonal near 400 C; seed layers known; incremental.
ZettaCore porphyrin molecular memory precedent; small charge per node and integration stalled before.
Electrolytic-capacitor self-healing applied to ALD films; DRAM tail is mostly junction leakage, not dielectric.
Standard retention macro makes access-device trials comparable and cheap; needs a host fab willing to run BEOL-only lots.
Inductive wafer-level test known in research; whole-wafer coil powering in an oven is the new twist.
Hydrogen barriers known from FeRAM/IGZO; 1.2-1.5x guard-band gain is incremental.
HWCVD doped micro-crystalline Si known from solar; contact resistance at DRAM dimensions uncertain.
Light sensitivity of WLCSP known; backside coatings are standard; niche segment.
